description: The file 'remote-ext.c' is a source code file written in C for a Git extension that manages remote command execution and request handling. It includes functions for parsing command line arguments, handling escape sequences, and communicating with subprocesses, indicating core logic for a Git remote extension command.

methods.name: char * strip_escapes(const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)

methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, expanding escape sequences into proper arguments.

methods.name: void send_git_request(int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a Git protocol request over a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: int run_child(const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Creates and runs a child process with provided arguments, handling Git protocol requests.

methods.name: int command_loop(const char * child)
methods.description: Main loop processing commands received on stdin, such as 'connect' and 'capabilities'.

methods.name: int cmd_remote_ext(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the remote-ext command, initiating the command loop.
